headline: Early winter grips central Europe, Munich sees first snow
body_text:
BERLIN, Oct 14 (APN) - An unusually early blast of polar air brought the first snow of the season to Munich on Tuesday and pushed daytime temperatures in much of Germany, Switzerland and Austria down to between 2 and 6 degrees Celsius, weather services said.

In Switzerland, snow fell down to about 1,000 metres overnight, briefly closing mountain passes. Copenhagen and Amsterdam saw their coldest mid-October days in more than a decade.

Retailers said the cold had sparked a rush for winter coats after a mild September. Germany's DWD expects milder air to return from around Oct 20.
